name: audio-tools
description: Audio Tools CLI — speech-to-text, text-to-speech, summarization, audio processing, provider lifecycle, and diagnostics over the audio-tools Connect-RPC API.

commands.name: transcribe
commands.description: Transcribe an audio file

flags.name: file
flags.description: Audio file path

flags.name: language
flags.description: Language hint (empty = auto-detect)

flags.name: format
flags.description: Audio format hint (default wav)

commands.name: transcribe-stream
commands.description: Stream-transcribe an audio file (emits one line per stream event)

flags.name: file
flags.description: Audio file path

flags.name: language
flags.description: Language hint (empty = auto-detect)

flags.name: chunk-bytes
flags.description: Chunk size to feed the stream in bytes (default 32768)

commands.name: formats
commands.description: Show the STT ingress audio-format capability matrix (accepted input codecs + ffmpeg/canonical-PCM status).

commands.name: engines
commands.description: List selectable STT engines (manifest-derived) with availability and the active selection.

commands.name: engine-impact
commands.description: Show the shared-resource impact of switching away from an engine (which other scenarios still use its resource + the stop command). Never stops anything.

commands.name: stream-config
commands.description: Show the resolved streaming STT configuration (engine + operator levers + egress gate + legacy partial-window fields).

commands.name: stream-config-set
commands.description: Update one or more streaming STT levers. Only provided flags are mutated.

flags.name: engine
flags.description: Active STT engine id (see `stt engines`); only the Local tier honors it

flags.name: streaming-mode
flags.description: auto|off — master switch (default auto)

flags.name: strategy-preference
flags.description: auto|vad|overlap|passthrough — strategy hint (default auto)

flags.name: vad-silence-ms
flags.description: VAD silence window in ms; range 200–3000 (default 1200)

flags.name: overlap-window-ms
flags.description: Sliding-window size for overlap-and-agree; range 1000–5000 (default 2000)

flags.name: overlap-commit-runs
flags.description: Consecutive agreeing runs to commit a prefix; range 2–4 (default 2)

flags.name: overlap-max-stall-rejects
flags.description: Force-commit the freshest hypothesis tail after N consecutive overlap divergence-rejects (bounds tail growth before the max_window_ms net); range 1–10, 0 disables (default 3)

flags.name: hallucination-filter
flags.description: true|false — drop known Whisper silence-hallucination phrases (default true)

flags.name: vad-filter
flags.description: true|false — enable faster-whisper's built-in silence filter on /asr (default true)

flags.name: no-speech-threshold
flags.description: Egress drop when mean no_speech_prob exceeds this AND avg_logprob is below logprob-threshold; range (0,1] (default 0.6)

flags.name: logprob-threshold
flags.description: Paired with no-speech-threshold; range [-10,0) (default -1.0)

flags.name: denoise
flags.description: true|false — pre-recognition ffmpeg afftdn denoise on the canonical-PCM stream (Whisper vad/overlap only; needs ffmpeg). Default off

commands.name: speaker-status
commands.description: Show speaker-verification config, resource capability, and enrolled profiles. Notes the Whisper-only protection caveat.

commands.name: speaker-config
commands.description: Update speaker-verification config. Only provided flags are mutated.

flags.name: mode
flags.description: off|filter|advisory — verification mode (off disables gating)

flags.name: threshold
flags.description: Cosine-similarity accept threshold; 0..1 (default 0.5; same-speaker high, different low)

flags.name: enabled
flags.description: true|false — master enable for speaker verification

flags.name: profiles
flags.description: Comma-separated profile ids to set as the active binding (replaces the list)

flags.name: bind-profile
flags.description: Append a single profile id to the active binding (reads current list first)

flags.name: reject-behavior
flags.description: drop|show-muted — what to do with a rejected segment (default drop)

flags.name: fallback
flags.description: true|false — let audio through when no profile/resource is available

flags.name: extraction-enabled
flags.description: true|false — isolate the enrolled speaker's voice BEFORE recognition (ingress target extraction; needs an enrolled profile + the extraction-capable resource; default false)

flags.name: min-decision-seconds
flags.description: Warm-up window: voiced seconds that must accrue before the session verifier may reject (0 = server default)

flags.name: score-smoothing
flags.description: EMA alpha 0..1 applied to per-segment scores so the session decision stops swinging (0 = server default)

commands.name: speaker-enroll
commands.description: Append one or more enrollment clips to a voice profile. --file is comma-separated for multi-clip enroll; --activate binds+enables in one step.

flags.name: file
flags.description: Audio file path(s); comma-separated to enroll several clips in one call (each appended)

flags.name: profile
flags.description: Profile id (empty = server-generated; reused across the batch)

flags.name: name
flags.description: Human display name for the profile

flags.name: label
flags.description: Condition label for the clip(s), e.g. laptop-normal or phone-whisper

flags.name: notes
flags.description: Optional notes stored with the profile

flags.name: format
flags.description: Audio format hint (default wav)

flags.name: activate
flags.description: true|false — bind as active profile and enable verification (default off)

commands.name: speaker-clips
commands.description: List the enrollment clips of a speaker profile.

flags.name: profile
flags.description: Profile id

commands.name: speaker-delete-clip
commands.description: Delete one enrollment clip from a profile (recomputes the centroid; deleting the last clip deletes the profile).

flags.name: profile
flags.description: Profile id

flags.name: clip
flags.description: Clip id to delete

commands.name: list

flags.name: tag

flags.name: limit
flags.description: Max clips to return (0 = no limit)

commands.name: import
commands.description: Import an s16le-mono-PCM audio file + reference transcript as a corpus clip

positionals.name: audio-file
positionals.description: Path to the audio file (s16le mono PCM preferred — the recorder's format)

flags.name: reference
flags.description: Ground-truth transcript text (inline)

flags.name: reference-file
flags.description: Path to a file holding the ground-truth transcript

flags.name: tags
flags.description: Comma-separated tags

flags.name: format
flags.description: Audio format hint (default pcm_s16le)

flags.name: sample-rate
flags.description: Sample rate in Hz (default 16000)

flags.name: scripted
flags.description: Mark the clip as a scripted-prompt reading (default free-form)

commands.name: get
commands.description: Show one corpus clip's metadata

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a corpus clip (metadata row + audio blob)

groups.name: experiment
groups.description: Manage persisted async STT experiments: start, watch, wait, report, and compare runs. --json uses proto snake_case and emits default scalar metrics so zero WER/latency/deltas are explicit.

commands.name: start
commands.description: Enqueue an async STT experiment and return immediately with its persisted id. Boolean flags (--long-form, --speaker-extraction, --speaker-verification, --speaker-fallback, --speaker-ablation) accept true|false; passing the flag with no value means true. Example: audio-tools experiment start --name baseline --strategies batch,vad_segment,overlap_agree --clip-ids c1,c2 --json Pass --dry-run to validate/resolve a recipe without enqueuing.

flags.name: name
flags.description: Human label for the experiment

flags.name: strategies
flags.description: Comma-separated strategy kinds (batch,vad_segment,overlap_agree); default server trio

flags.name: clip-ids
flags.description: Comma-separated corpus clip ids to evaluate (default: whole corpus)

flags.name: realtime-repeats
flags.description: Real-time-paced runs per clip for latency p50/p95 (0 = quality only)

flags.name: latency-tail-seconds
flags.description: When realtime repeats are enabled, fast-feed the prefix and pace only the final N seconds at 1x (0 = full real-time pacing)

flags.name: chunk-ms
flags.description: Replay chunk size in ms (default 100)

flags.name: dropped-span-threshold
flags.description: Contiguous deleted reference-word threshold for the safety gate (default 4)

flags.name: overlap-max-window-ms
flags.description: Overlap-agree max uncommitted tail window in ms before force-commit (default 25000)

flags.name: overlap-max-stall-rejects
flags.description: Overlap-agree stall-fallback rejected-window limit; 0 disables, absent uses stream-config default

flags.name: overlap-window-ms
flags.description: Overlap-agree comparison window in ms (0 = stream-config default)

flags.name: overlap-commit-runs
flags.description: Overlap-agree matching-run count required before commit (0 = stream-config default)

flags.name: vad-silence-ms
flags.description: VAD segment silence threshold in ms (0 = stream-config default)

flags.name: seed
flags.description: Seed for deterministic long-form clip ordering (default 1 when long-form is enabled)

flags.name: long-form
flags.description: true|false — concatenate selected corpus clips into one seeded long-form input

flags.name: target-duration-seconds
flags.description: Keep concatenating seeded corpus clips until this approximate input duration is reached

flags.name: gap-ms
flags.description: Silence gap inserted between clips in long-form inputs (default 5000)

flags.name: tag-contains
flags.description: Restrict long-form source clips to corpus clips whose tags contain this substring

flags.name: sweep-durations
flags.description: Comma-separated long-form input durations in SECONDS to evaluate as separate length conditions (e.g. 30,60,120,300); setting this implies --long-form

flags.name: noise-types
flags.description: Comma-separated generated noise beds to mix across the full input; one of: white, fan, percussive, music (unknown types are rejected up front)

flags.name: snr-db
flags.description: Comma-separated SNR levels in dB for augmentation conditions; 0 = noise as loud as speech, negative = noise louder (default 12 when augmentation is enabled)

flags.name: competing-voices
flags.description: Comma-separated Kokoro voice ids to synthesize as competing speakers

flags.name: competing-text
flags.description: Text spoken by each synthesized competing voice

flags.name: target-profile-id
flags.description: Speaker profile id for target-speaker extraction/verification experiment conditions

flags.name: speaker-extraction
flags.description: true|false — enable target-speaker extraction for the recipe condition

flags.name: speaker-verification
flags.description: true|false — enable egress speaker verification for the recipe condition

flags.name: speaker-mode
flags.description: Speaker verification mode: off, filter, or advisory

flags.name: speaker-threshold
flags.description: Speaker verification cosine threshold (default 0.5)

flags.name: speaker-fallback
flags.description: true|false — allow unverified text when the speaker resource cannot decide

flags.name: speaker-ablation
flags.description: true|false — evaluate extraction/verification off/on combinations for attribution

flags.name: estimated-seconds
flags.description: Optional client-visible runtime estimate in seconds

flags.name: recipe-json
flags.description: Inline JSON ExperimentRecipe (protojson) used as the BASE recipe; any individual --flags you also pass override its fields. Mutually exclusive with --recipe-file

flags.name: recipe-file
flags.description: Path to a JSON file holding an ExperimentRecipe (protojson) used as the BASE recipe; individual --flags override its fields. Mutually exclusive with --recipe-json

flags.name: dry-run
flags.description: Validate and resolve the recipe and print the preview WITHOUT enqueuing anything

commands.name: get
commands.description: Show one experiment's persisted lifecycle state and run cells.

commands.name: wait
commands.description: Block once until an experiment reaches a terminal state; canceling the client does not abort the run. With --json, terminal experiments include the stored report envelope (experiment, report, runs) when available; otherwise the lifecycle envelope is returned. Example: audio-tools experiment wait <id> --json

commands.name: list
commands.description: List persisted experiments newest first, optionally filtered by status.

flags.name: status
flags.description: queued|running|succeeded|failed|canceled

flags.name: limit
flags.description: Maximum experiments to return (0 = server default)

flags.name: offset
flags.description: Pagination offset

commands.name: cancel
commands.description: Cancel a queued or running experiment.

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a terminal experiment, its run rows, and its stored report blob. Requires --yes confirmation.

flags.name: yes
flags.description: Confirm deletion

commands.name: watch
commands.description: Stream in-memory progress events for one active experiment.

commands.name: report
commands.description: Fetch an experiment's stored report artifact and run-cell condition rows. --json returns {experiment, report, runs}; report metrics use snake_case with zero/default scalar fields emitted. Example: audio-tools experiment report <id> --json

commands.name: compare
commands.description: Compare two or more experiments by id, showing each one's winning strategy, WER, p95 latency, calls, RTF, and safety gate, with deltas vs the best (lowest-WER) experiment. Ids may be space-separated AND/OR comma-separated. Experiments still running (no report) appear as a row with their status. Use --json for full recipes and reports with explicit zero/default scalar metrics. Example: audio-tools experiment compare <id-a> <id-b> --json

positionals.name: ids
positionals.description: Experiment ids, space- and/or comma-separated (e.g. `id-a id-b` or `id-a,id-b`)
